id: \bAhoy, there!\nWhere do you want to sail?
en: \bAhoy, there!\nWhere do you want to sail?

id: \bThe Tiall Region it is. All aboard!
en: \bThe Tiall Region it is.  All aboard!
it: \bRegione di Tiall, allora.  Tutti a bordo!

id: \bLet me know if you want to set sail.
en: \bLet me know if you want to set sail.

id: \bYou can use that to sail to Daroxy Island.
en: \bYou can use that to sail to Daroxy Island.
it: \bPuoi usarlo per salpare verso l'Isola Daroxy.

id: \bOh, you don't have any space in your Bag for it.
en: \bOh, you don't have any space in your Bag for it.
it: \bOh, non hai spazio nella Borsa per prenderlo.

id: \bI've already given you an Aurora Ticket. Have you gone to Daroxy Island yet?
en: \bI've already given you an Aurora Ticket.  Have you gone to Daroxy Island yet?
it: \bTi ho già dato un Biglietto Aurora.  Sei già stato all'Isola Daroxy?

id: \bYou can use that to sail to Faraday Island.
en: \bYou can use that to sail to Faraday Island.
it: \bPuoi usarla per salpare verso l'Isola Faraday.

id: \bI've already given you an Old Sea Map. Have you gone to Faraday Island yet?
en: \bI've already given you an Old Sea Map.  Have you gone to Faraday Island yet?
it: \bTi ho già dato una Mappa Stinta.  Sei già stato all'Isola Faraday?
